reason: The fix normalizes culture to lowercase only on the query side without showing that LocalizedContentItemIndex.Culture is populated with the same lowercase normalization, so on case-sensitive databases this could either fix or newly break culture matching for localized content lookups, sitemaps, and contained list items depending on unseen indexing code.
